## History

Violetta was an imaginary friend conceived by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as a little girl living in a valley. She existed as an echo that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) envisioned as a great companion during her earlier years. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) frequently conversed with this imagined figure, using her to process her surroundings and cope with her solitary childhood prior to coming to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
